verdict.rationale: Google Voice's own admin docs describe a number-porting flow. Admins enter up to 1000 landline/VoIP numbers, pick an activation date, and ports are tracked per losing carrier account or BTN. In other countries Google provides a template for the customer to fill in with details matching the port order, and community users report porting numbers in. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of collecting losing-carrier account details (account number/PIN) in the order form, a documented LOA or e-signature step for US ports, and confirmation that Google itself files and manages the port with the losing carrier.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my existing number in: the provider collects the losing carrier's account details and letter of authorization and files the port

citations.quote: If your organization has existing phone numbers with another service provider, you can port (or move) those numbers to Google Voice.
Landline or VoIP—Enter up to 1000 phone numbers (50 in Canada), separated by commas.
you cannot have more than one active simultaneous port from a single losing carrier account or BTN.
In other countries Google Voice provides a template to download for the customer to fill in with details matching the port order
